tests.name: reward sweep is mounted and refuses an unauthenticated run (JSON 401)

tests.reason: Paying a reward is a write and staging shares the production database, so payouts are proven off staging: the capped claim and sweep candidates by applying the migration twice over a local replica of the live wallet tables with the real credit_wallet (scripts/ci/test-vtid-04878-capped-rewards.sh, run inside the migration suite, mutation-checked), and the sweep, milestone payer, production gate and /complete payout by the gateway suites. On staging the sweep refuses with 409 NOT_PRODUCTION before any query (proven in vtid-04878-reward-routes).
